name: Bakonycsernye (Hungary)
description: White field charged at the centre with the municipal arms of Bakonycsernye (a blue and green shield with a church, hills and a tree) below the name BAKONYCSERNYE in light blue.
history: The municipality inaugurated its arms and flag in 1997. Hungarian municipal symbols are adopted by decree of the local representative body (képviselő-testület); the flag carries the colours of the municipal arms.
